imaging.interpretation: Identical imaging settings are an experiment, not approved scientific-error tolerances. Auto-masks are separately estimated in each image; CLEAN path changes are part of the measured effect.

hardware.cache_methodology: No cache eviction; shared host with concurrent encoding/imaging and unrelated workloads

screen.sampling: Up to 128 evenly spaced quantization groups per product; all frequency segments. Deterministic, not random or a whole-MS estimate.
screen.limitations: Different groupings sample different values. Rates exclude metadata, maps, quality arrays and HDF5 overhead. Use full encodes and images for selection.

first_integration_controls.scope: Full first integration only; 62128 baselines, 48 channels, four products; identical MSE ceilings do not imply identical achieved errors

imaging.wsclean_version:
WSClean version 3.7 (2026-02-16)
Git commit hash: v3.7-79-g2d5c1ed8
This software package is released under the GPL version 3.
Author: André Offringa (offringa@gmail.com).

EveryBeam is available.
IDG is available.
WGridder is available.
imaging.interpretation: Identical imaging settings are an experiment, not approved scientific-error tolerances. Auto-masks are separately estimated in each image; CLEAN path changes are part of the measured effect.

limitations: Only joint Stokes I imaging of this 15-integration dataset; no Q/U/V, calibration solutions, light curves or held-out observations tested.
Eight-thread lossless and repeated-source runs measure imaging variability; two controls do not establish its statistical distribution.
All image metrics, peaks and apertures use the same all-integration >10 degree elevation mask.
Archive ratios relative to original input include intentional raw/model/flagged-value removal; use the lossless calibrated-only comparator for incremental quantization.
Shared host, warm/unspecified caches and concurrent workloads. Encode-only excludes inspection; verified-bundle includes partition copy, inspection and verification.
The Stokes-I-priority profile relaxes XY/YX bounds; no polarization fidelity claim is supported.
Selection uses this dataset and its images; no general archive defaults or scientific acceptance are established.
